# SEO & GEO Studio
> Hospitality Search Engine and Generative Engine Optimization Suite

SEO & GEO Studio provides battle-tested SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and structured data frameworks purpose-built for hospitality and hotel digital marketing.

- Website: https://seo-studio.vercel.app
- Documentation: https://seo-studio.vercel.app/architecture
- GitHub: https://github.com/nurunnobejisan/SEO-Studio

## Core System Modules
- Strategy Matrix: https://seo-studio.vercel.app/strategy-matrix (78-Keyword hospitality matrix across Brand, Local, Amenities, Meetings, Extended Stay, and GEO)
- System Architecture: https://seo-studio.vercel.app/architecture (Manifest V3 extension, multi-tier routing, and local data vaults)
- Templates Hub: https://seo-studio.vercel.app/templates (Catalog of 12 production-ready SEO & GEO templates)
